video_title: Rose Namajunas Interview | Lord's Prayer, Joanna & UFC Journey

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on her winning formula in the octagon
quotes.excerpt: I figured out my formula to success is punch them in the face, take their back, choke them out.
quotes.quote: I figured out my formula to success is punch them in the face, take their back, choke them out.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on using positive affirmations before her fights
quotes.excerpt: I had a viral moment where I was shouting to myself like, I'm the best, I'm the best.
quotes.quote: I had a viral moment where I was shouting to myself like, I'm the best, I'm the best. And I go to knock the girl out and so it happened before, so I had to draw, tap back into that.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on finding a career path through martial arts
quotes.excerpt: I was always just trying to look for a way out. I need to figure out a career path.
quotes.quote: I was always just trying to look for a way out. I need to figure out a career path for myself and I lean into sports a lot because I'm fairly smart, but I definitely have more gifts I think in the athletic side of things.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on her personal growth and healing process
quotes.excerpt: I've healed so much from my past, my relationship with God is so much stronger.
quotes.quote: I've healed so much from my past, my relationship with God is so much stronger. So it's like I'm just not working through a lot of that stuff anymore and I'm just way more content and happy with everything.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on maintaining focus during a fight
quotes.excerpt: OK I just got to focus on winning, I can't worry about this.
quotes.quote: OK I just got to focus on winning, I can't worry about this. The only thing that got me through was like, all right, win, win, win. How do I win?

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on the pressure of fighting Joanna Jedrzejczyk
quotes.excerpt: She was the boogie woman, everyone thought I was just going to die.
quotes.quote: She was the boogie woman, everyone thought I was just going to die. And I believed, it was such a spiritual battle for me, I was going through a lot and there was so much.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on fighting Weili Zhang
quotes.excerpt: She was considered the unbeatable person at the time.
quotes.quote: She was considered the unbeatable person at the time. I thought to myself that first fight when I became champion, I'm like, man, if I could ever feel like this another time in my life, I knew that it was just like a special moment.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on the dangers of excessive weight cutting
quotes.excerpt: I think fighters cut too much weight, to be honest.
quotes.quote: I think fighters cut too much weight, to be honest. I don't like when they cut so much weight and their last few cuts were definitely, I just didn't like how I was looking and just in my face and stuff and it's a tough cut.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on the psychological impact of her fights
quotes.excerpt: Most of the girls that she fought would lose the fight before it even started.
quotes.quote: Most of the girls that she fought would lose the fight before it even started. They would talk them out of the fight in a way, like psychologically. So I kind of was prepared for that.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on her strategy for dealing with trash talk
quotes.quote: Just don't react to it. Because she's going to get more and more louder and aggressive each time that we face off with each other and it's exactly what happened.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on her priorities as a professional fighter
quotes.excerpt: As long as I'm happy, healthy and safe — that's my number one job.
quotes.quote: As long as I'm happy, healthy and safe — that's my number one job. I got to protect myself at all times, that's my number one job. So as long as I can go home to my family and we're all good.

quotes.speaker: Rose Namajunas
quotes.summary_phrase: Rose Namajunas on her gratitude for her fighting career
quotes.excerpt: I just have ultimate gratitude for everything that it's done for me in my life.
quotes.quote: I just have ultimate gratitude for everything that it's done for me in my life and my family and everything. So I have ultimate gratitude for everything that it's done for me in my life.
